label: kind-ladder
ok: {kind-ladder-incomplete} silent ladders, {kind-ladder-split} split walks (baseline or below)
remedy:
A ladder over a closed kind set is exhaustive over it, or ends in a
default that NAMES what it excludes — an `emitFail`, a sentence, or a
delegation to the ladder that owns the rest. After a real fix, lower the
baseline with
